question: A _________ displays information in visual form, using text and graphics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monitor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A monitor is an electronic output device that is used to display images, text, video, and graphics information generated by a connected computer.
 
• It is an **output device that displays information in pictorial form.**&l
